sections.Aims and Fit of Module: The aim of the module is to bring together students, supervisors, and relevant stakeholders to carefully define the problem, its scope, and its boundaries. By the end of the module, a revised and upgraded project charter will be formulated, alongside a detailed plan for investigating and analysing the problem. The module will also establish regular review and progression meeting mechanisms to ensure continuous project movement.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Clearly articulate a problem, including its scope, boundaries, and key deliverables. B. Develop a project charter by appropriately engaging stakeholders. C. Use Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) to propose a project schedule. D. Formulate the project budget and duration baseline with justifications. E. Develop mechanisms for tracking milestones, performance, and task outcomes.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: • Collaborative Discussions: Group discussions with students, supervisors, and stakeholders to align on the project’s scope, boundaries, and objectives. • Expert Presentations: Industry professionals and faculty members will present best practices in problem definition, project management, and investigation methods. • Workshops for Charter Formulation: Collaborative work to draft and refine the project charter, ensuring all aspects, including scope, deliverables, and timelines, are well-defined.
